last sunday’s collection amounted to € 545.00 we thank you for your generosity. diocesan collection: last weekend’s collection for mission sunday came to €313.00. thanks to all contributed to the collection. parish deaths: mass on sunday, november 15th will be offered for all who died in the parish in the past twelve months. we will also remember and pray for all, who were born and grew up in our parish, who have died elsewhere. november mass: you are invited to the annual november mass for all those who have died within the hospital over the past year, including those who have died in palliative care services , maternity services, the relatives of hospital staff and former staff members of university hospital kerry. the mass will be celebrated on monday 2nd november 7pm in st john’s church, castle street, tralee. the mass will also be live streamed for those unable to attend in person on

first saturdays conference: this year's conference will take place in knock on saturday november 28th. the day begins at 10am and finishes at 5pm. it includes holy mass, adoration, talks , and a healing service. speakers include: fr patrick cahill, geraldine o'donnell, fr leon perei nikki kingsley, fr marius o'reilly, fr. jaimie twohig, christine o'hara, fr. mark quinn, and fr philip kemmy, fr. john keane will lead a eucharistic healing service. more information and the list of buses going are available on
the parish office at the presbytery is open on fridays from 9.30 –13.00. phone 087 – 6538782. email:
